_note: Indian festival calendar driving seasonal content placement. lead_days is how far BEFORE the festival the post should run - a Diwali campaign-planning post is worthless on Diwali day, because brands lock those budgets six to eight weeks earlier. weight ranks commercial importance for beauty and fashion (3 = peak trading).
_accuracy_warning: Dates marked approx=true follow the lunar calendar and shift year to year. These are best estimates and SHOULD be verified against a 2027 panchang before the content runs. Fixed-date and solar festivals (Republic Day, Valentine's, Baisakhi, Christmas) are reliable.
